name: list_files
description: list_files must descend when asked. Recursion was broken from the day the tool was added and every gate stayed green: the host marks directories with a trailing slash, the tool asked the host about each name with the slash still attached, and a path ending in a slash is refused, so nothing was ever a directory. It hid because the names kept their slashes into the output, and a recursive listing looked exactly like a correct one-level listing. The assertion is a file that only a descent can reach, so a repeat fails here rather than in a hand probe months later.
prompt: Use the list_files tool on path "src" with recursive set to true and suffix ".zig". src/agent/loop.zig lives one directory down, so only a recursive listing reaches it. Answer with only YES if the returned entries include src/agent/loop.zig, otherwise NO.
